title: From extensions to a running script
description: Extensions describe their Luau surface without a VM. The planner composes them, assigns every tag, atom and slot, and renders the type definitions. Each runtime built from the plan gets its own VM with exactly that shape, and scripts run in sandboxes the host can measure.

stages.title: Extension::describe
stages.detail: Modules and their typed members, userdata types under stable keys with tag and compiler-slot policies, packed kinds, services, capabilities, memory categories, lowering hooks. No VM is touched.

stages.title: RuntimePlan::finalize
stages.detail: Orders extensions by dependency, merges owners with augmenters, assigns tags, Luau's 32 compiler slots, atoms and direct slots, validates every identifier and path, and inserts the dream.net bridge.

stages.title: Runtime::from_plan
stages.detail: A VM with the planned metatables, generic direct-access callbacks, opened and frozen modules, every extension's install run in order, and compiler metadata for the compatibility globals. Any number per plan.

stages.title: Sandbox
stages.detail: OpenMW's prelude, one environment per script instance cloned from a compiled template, and the watchdog, memory categories and call scopes around every call.

alongside.label: the plan renders
alongside.title: Type definitions
alongside.detail: The composition's declare extern type grammar, served to Luau's analysis frontend and type checked against strict scripts in the crate's tests, so the declared API and the runtime cannot drift.

alongside.label: with the jit feature
alongside.title: Native code
alongside.detail: Lowering hooks written in Rust compile annotated call sites to IR: quaternions, colours and vertex writes with no C call, exiting to the interpreter only on malformed input.
